scope: Gate 3 provider discovery, LOG10 1.2.5 pre-order proof, bounded local forward-lifecycle implementation, and official Workbench readiness only

official_contract.title: ONDC - API Contract for Logistics (v1.2.5)
official_contract.baseline_search: Immediate Delivery, P2P by ONDC:LOG10, fulfillment.type=Delivery
official_contract.immediate_delivery_forward_requirement: LSP performs inline rider check in on_init; LBNP confirm carries order preparation estimate and ready_to_ship=yes; LBNP later sends order_ready=yes by update
official_contract.compatibility_rule: 1.2.5 is side-by-side compatible with 1.2.0; a 1.2.0 response is accepted only after that BPP advertises 1.2.0, and 1.2.5 features are enabled only from discovery

signed_search.test_payload: 1 kg non-dangerous Grocery parcel, Immediate Delivery, P2P, Bengaluru PreProd coordinates, no order/payment/shipment

correlated_on_search.scope_selection: I1 forward Delivery only; the separate RTO quote/fulfillment was not selected

provider_evidence.claim_boundary: The outgoing search was signed and the callbacks were transaction/message correlated. The currently deployed callback owner did not verify or durably record the inbound Authorization signature, so these callbacks are discovery evidence, not signed conformance proof.

behavior: Dedicated /api/ondc/logistics search/init/confirm/update/status/track routes use only the LBNP identity and keys
LOG10 is fixed to 1.2.5, Immediate Delivery, P2P forward scope; Retail select and non-Delivery scope fail closed
Existing durable outbox/inbox transport is reused
Durable outbox retries derive their signer from the envelope domain so LOG10 retries remain LBNP-signed
LOG10 callbacks require a current SUBSCRIBED BPP registry record and a matching Ed25519 Authorization signature before ACK/persistence
A 1.2.0 post-search callback is accepted only after the same BPP advertised 1.2.0 in a correlated on_search
Third-party registry lookup no longer injects the caller's unique key ID
implementation.commerce_v1_boundary: No CommerceV1 mutation was added: this conformance flow uses protocol test orders only and must not mutate a real/demo retail order or create a second fulfilment owner.
fail_before: The dedicated LOG10 route regression returned HTTP 404
Third-party lookup injected the Buyer caller key ID and the registry returned NACK 15045 no matching participant
pass_after: Dedicated LOG10 regression passed with the LBNP key/domain/version and unsupported select/non-Immediate scope rejected
Registry-matched callback signature passes and a body tamper NACKs with HTTP 401
Black check and git diff check passed
